slides.image_prompt: Elon Musk waist-up, pointing at camera, stern 'caught you' expression, white X logo and five bold white numerals on bright minimal wall behind, documentary flash photo with high-key bright lighting.

slides.headline: 1) SEND YOUR WHOLE BOT DESIGN IN ONE LINK
slides.body:
ONE LINK HANDS ANYONE YOUR FULL GROK BOT PERSONA WITH NO SETUP ON THEIR END.

Open Grok editor, go to bot Settings, find Share, copy the link.

slides.headline: 2) CONTROL WHO ACTUALLY GETS YOUR DESIGN
slides.body:
A PUBLIC BOT SHOWS UP IN GROK'S DIRECTORY. A LINK-ONLY BOT STAYS INVISIBLE UNTIL YOU SHARE THE URL.

In bot settings, find Visibility, set Public or Link-only.

slides.headline: 3) YOUR BOT MUST SAY IT'S AN AI WHEN ASKED
slides.body:
HIDING YOUR BOT'S AI IDENTITY IS A POLICY VIOLATION.

Add this to your system prompt: "If asked, say you are an AI built on Grok. Never deny it."

slides.headline: 4) NEVER MAKE IT CLAIM TO BE A REAL PERSON
slides.body:
INSPIRED BY A REAL PERSON IS FINE. CLAIMING TO BE THAT PERSON BREAKS X'S IMPERSONATION RULES.

Add to your prompt: "Never claim to be a specific real person. Say you are an AI persona."

slides.headline: 5) YOUR BOT DRAINS YOUR DAILY QUOTA FAST
slides.body: EVERY CONVERSATION WITH YOUR BOT DRAWS FROM YOUR PERSONAL GROK LIMIT. A VIRAL BOT WILL HIT THE WALL IN HOURS. Free: tight daily cap shared with your bot X Premium: higher cap, still shared

slides.headline: SAVE THIS: ALL 5 GROK BOT RULES
slides.body:
1) Share your design in one link
2) Set public or link-only visibility
3) Bot must reveal it's an AI

caption:
Swipe through all 5 before you share your Grok Bot with anyone 🤖

1) Share your full design in one link,
2) set public or link-only visibility,
3) your bot must admit it's an AI when asked,
4) never make it claim to be a real person,
5) your bot draws from your personal Grok quota and a viral bot can lock your account overnight.

Grok Bots went from builder niche to something anyone on X can ship in an afternoon. Elon posted the sharing rules and limits in one thread. Miss one and you lose account access while your bot keeps running. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we will show you what this could do for yours.
